definitions.explanation: Extremely angry. Used to describe someone who is visibly enraged.
Describes intense, beating heat from the sun.
The sound of metal being struck repeatedly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}して→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かんかん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{怒|おこ}られた→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: I was late and got furiously scolded by the teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約束|やくそく}を{破|やぶ}った→約束を破る：20639_yakusokuwoyaburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧かんかん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{怒|おこ}っている→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: She's absolutely livid because he broke his promise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真夏|まなつ}→真夏：27793_manatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧かんかん{照|で}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked in the blazing midsummer sun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かんかん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}りつけて→照りつける：19550_teritsukeru⟧、⟦アスファルト→アスファルト：10736_asufaruto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熱|あつ}く→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦なっていた→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The sun was blazing down and the asphalt had become hot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かんかん⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧。
⟦{踏切|ふみきり}→踏切：06493_fumikiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かんかん⟦{鳴|な}っている→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: The railroad crossing alarm is clanging.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧かんかん⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{金属音|きんぞくおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧きた。
examples.english: A clanging metallic sound could be heard from the construction site.

notes:
USAGE:
The three meanings of かんかん are distinct and context makes clear which is intended.

Sense 1 (furious) most commonly appears in the pattern かんかん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧. It can also be used as a na-adjective predicate: かんかんだ.

Sense 2 (scorching) almost always appears in the fixed expression かんかん{照|で}り (blazing sunshine).

Sense 3 (clanging) is onomatopoeic, representing the sound of metal being struck.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- かんかん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧: to be furious
- かんかん{照|で}り: blazing sunshine
- かんかん⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: to clang
